consumes.surface_spec: SURFACE-SPECS.md and exact entries in surface-manifest.json
consumes.microcopy: SURFACE-SPECS.md COPY-01 and source English field/action labels via FIELD-01. Shared new copy uses the frozen copy/key table; no labels_en/labels_pt keys are presumed in surface JSON.
consumes.component_signatures: COMPONENT-CONTRACTS.md and component-signatures.ts; exact named public types/callbacks and ownership of effects, no inferred props.
consumes.host_signatures: host-signatures.ts owns the exact public/private type placement, provider dependency injection, auth/navigation, broker IPC and host callbacks; no inference or private import into browser.

required_reads.source_pins: Read only relevant producer paths from SOURCE-BASELINE + contract-catalog source records, re-pinned by launch-record.

deliver: Implement every field/action/state/route in the assigned surface entries; field source is authoritative, never an invitation to omit less visible controls.
Emit typed page/component exports and registration fragment to I00; no direct registry/shared producer writes.
Use frozen responsive/microcopy/dirty-navigation specification; add behavior-focused installed journey cases in the owned exact spec.
Publish exact en/pt-BR leaf copy symbols from i18n_exports; provide import/spread fragment for I00 orchestra.ts, no shared registry write.

acceptance_cases.expected: Annual/monthly edit, spread/reset, preview and save use producer commands; 12-month grid retains blank/zero/inherited/locked semantics.

All assigned surfaces implement READ-01 and the exact COMPONENT-CONTRACTS state mapping: filtered-empty retains filters; not-found is distinct from an empty collection; read-only/revoked map as specified. Draft reviewing/submitting/pending phases are separate from page state; late responses and return behavior preserve the authorized owner.
At 320/768/1024/1280/1440px and 200% text resize plus 400% reflow (1280px to 320 CSS px) the frozen flow retains fields/actions and keyboard access; themes use existing tokens.

gates.incremental: Use canonical ci_plan.dispatch_policy.incremental_validation and invalidation_matrix; exact changed specs plus transitive consumers, one dispatcher.
gates.execute_after: INTEGRATED and readiness satisfied; dispatcher resolves existing aliases before any request. Never invent workflow, runner or service.
gates.final: Canonical same-C gates remain; this work order cannot declare GLOBAL_RELEASE.
gates.typecheck_command: bun typecheck in each named package directory through the authorized compiler-only executor; never tsc directly.

stop: Unknown field, action, error, permission, route, export or schema => BLOCKED_CONTRACT for that output; publish exact question and source evidence; finish other independent authorized outputs.
Producer changed since locked family pin => BLOCKED_DRIFT for affected consumers; never silently rebase semantics or widen validation.
Required path outside owns or active foreign lease => BLOCKED_OWNER; provide complete inert patch to I00/current owner.
Live service absent => ARTIFACT_READY plus BLOCKED_INTEGRATION/QUALIFICATION; no stub, permissive substitute or synthetic receipt in production.
A failing unchanged input must not be rerun until causal change or a documented transient infrastructure cause is established.
No full-suite dispatch, merge, deploy, Azure, auth policy, financial rule or producer-engine change from this work order.

handoff.format: Canonical executor receipt plus protocol fields; source commit/tree, exact path/blob preimages/postimages, contracts digests, exports, tests not run/run evidence, blockers, consumer list, lease terminal.
handoff.slot_release: ARTIFACT_READY may be per named incremental output. After receipt and explicit owner handoff, release slot; next actor needs new bounded lease. No idle wait and no inferred expiry.
handoff.shared_changes: Exact proposed diff with preimage/postimage; I00 applies only after current owner release, without rewriting the author output.

i18n_exports.source: SURFACE-SPECS.md COPY-01 and original field labels; equal English values require existing policy classification
